profileContract.rationale: The technical overview and launch foundation define shared modules, services, controllers, UI surfaces, dependency direction, state ownership, data flow, and trust boundaries.
Identical normalized inputs must produce stable formation results, score traces, RNG records, migrations, operation receipts, pack recovery, and trade settlement outcomes.
The launch foundation defines invalid input, service failure, storage failure, authorization failure, partial completion, retryability, quarantine, safe mode, rollback, and operator evidence.

profileContract.plan_section: Data-Driven Generalization and Future Aspect Boundary
profileContract.rationale: The architecture must represent launch fixtures without special cases, scale through data-driven catalogs, support all required devices, and preserve the exhaustive future aspect without implementing it early.

profileContract.plan_section: Product Inputs, Outputs, and Observable Workflows
profileContract.rationale: The product vision, content catalog, and launch foundation define player inputs, server outputs, interfaces, actions, schemas, content, and observable first-release behavior.

profileContract.plan_section: Rollout, Rollback, Publication, and Production Acceptance
profileContract.rationale: Build, private soft launch, controlled public rollout, observability, rollback, documentation, and production acceptance are defined, while external Roblox identities, permissions, authorizations, cohort evidence, and commerce access remain prerequisites.
The sources define server authority, payload validation, rate limits, ownership checks, privacy, secret handling, trade safety, policy checks, moderation evidence, and adversarial tests.
The sources define durable and transient state, schema versioning, session ownership, UpdateAsync writes, migrations, journals, retries, corruption handling, size budgets, and recovery.
Pure, integration, Studio, multiclient, migration, security, failure injection, performance, accessibility, recovery, and real-workflow verification are required.
Stable IDs, catalog versions, configuration versions, profile schemas, operation receipts, migrations, tool artifacts, and public compatibility boundaries are explicitly covered.

optionalFutureScope.summary: Add the remaining forty-nine original Deck Sets in small health-gated themed waves until all fifty-two sets and 2,704 base identities exist.
Add Diamond through Unknown Editions and scale permanent form tracking from 624 launch forms to all 37,856 forms.
Add the remaining twelve Traits and validate all twenty-four Trait interactions at end-state scale.
Add the remaining ninety-six Jokers and complete all six rarity groups and endgame interactions.
Add the remaining twenty-four Arcana and complete Edition, suit, rank, Grade, Power Tier, and Trait transformation families.
Introduce all twelve Souls, Soul Packs, Soul Fragments, and one equipped endgame global build rule.
Add the cooperative Boss Table, rotating boss mechanics, contribution rewards, endgame bosses, and cooperative seasons.
Add cross-server matchmaking and population-supported competitive ratings after same-server Friend Clash is healthy.
Add an escrowed cross-server listing market only after direct trade ledgers, moderation, price history, expiration, taxes, recovery, and abuse controls are proven.
Expand spectator presentation, wishlists, social showcases, clubs or crews, cooperative events, and seasonal live operations.
Consider story chapters, dialogue quests, or a larger navigable world only through a later explicit product-contract promotion.
Migrate large inventories to journaled shards and adopt deterministic mantissa-and-exponent numbers before platform storage or integer precision limits are approached.
Add multiple saved loadouts, complete Edition-grid rewards, expanded mastery, endgame album views, and final collection leaderboards.
Expand daily and weekly rotations, cosmetic season tracks, Packstorms, events, and measured retention systems after foundation health is proven.
Finish and enable direct trading in a later release if the initial public release uses the approved visibly disabled fallback.

nonGoals.summary: Do not use protected franchise characters, art, names, sounds, logos, interfaces, pack designs, screenshots, or imitation branding.
Do not present poker, blackjack, casino, betting, wagering, stakes, chips, dealers, jackpots, or cash-out mechanics.
Do not sell paid random gameplay packs, hidden luck, purchasable odds advantages, leaderboard power, or random power requirements.
Do not support real-money trading, Robux value display, player-to-player currency transfer, or wagering inventory.
Do not grant clients authority over inventory, RNG, scores, rewards, progression, prices, purchases, timestamps, trade ownership, or persistent state.
Do not make passive, offline, unattended, or held-input play the strongest progression path.
Do not use additional catalog volume to compensate for an unhealthy opening, collection, transformation, or Formation Rush loop.
Do not treat popularity, discovery rank, retention, spending, or audience size as guaranteed outcomes.
Do not require completion of the full fifty-two Deck Set and 37,856-form destination for the initial public release endpoint.
Do not change the GitHub repository's current public visibility as part of publishing the Roblox experience.

ownerDecisions.question: Which artifact owns initial-release completion authority?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: docs/general/plan.md is the authoritative initial public release plan and completion authority.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The launch requires one clear endpoint and one global phase sequence.

ownerDecisions.question: How is the exhaustive long-term destination represented?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: docs/general/full_plan.md is mandatory to author and register as a future aspect, but its execution remains excluded from initial-release completion.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The 52 by 52 destination has an independent lifecycle and substantial content matrix.

ownerDecisions.question: What exact content belongs to the initial public release?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: The launch contains three Deck Sets, 156 base identities, four Editions, 624 forms, eleven Grades, eleven Power Tiers, twelve Traits, twenty-four Jokers, twelve Arcana, twelve formations, and four active tasks.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This is the smallest foundation that exercises every essential collection and active-play axis.

ownerDecisions.question: What observable endpoint closes the master plan?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: A controlled public Roblox release closes the plan only after private soft launch and every mandatory initial-release gate pass.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Code completion without real release evidence does not prove the product endpoint.

ownerDecisions.question: Does direct trading block publication?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Trading is enabled only after every safety and production authorization gate passes; otherwise the public release proceeds with trading visibly disabled.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Public inventory safety is stronger than feature completeness.

ownerDecisions.question: What randomness and monetization model is allowed?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Gameplay packs are earned with visible odds and persistent pity; monetization is limited to guaranteed cosmetics and declared convenience without paid random power.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The model preserves transparent progression and avoids paid randomized gameplay power.

ownerDecisions.question: What originality and presentation boundary applies?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: All branding, art, audio, interfaces, effects, and writing are original, and the game uses Card Formations without casino, poker, betting, or wagering presentation.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Standard ranks and suits are generic building blocks, while every expressive product layer must be original and policy-safe.

ownerDecisions.question: Where does gameplay and persistent authority reside?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: The server owns inventory, RNG, scoring, rewards, progression, transactions, trades, purchases, policy decisions, and durable state; clients submit narrow intent and render results.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Every valuable or persistent outcome crosses an untrusted client boundary.

ownerDecisions.question: Which progress invariants are permanent?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Edition unlocks, discovery, Grade progress, pity rewards, instance identity, and ownership cannot silently regress or be destroyed by ordinary progression or balance changes.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Permanent collection progress is a core product promise.

ownerDecisions.question: How does active progress compare with passive progress?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Active play remains the primary path and must be at least five times as efficient as the passive baseline in verification fixtures.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Pack opening, deck decisions, tasks, and formations are the game; waiting is supplementary.

ownerDecisions.question: Which devices and accessibility modes are mandatory?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Every required activity supports touch, mouse, keyboard, controller, reduced motion, reduced flash, low graphics, readable rarity cues, and small-screen layouts.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The public Roblox experience must not make one input device or intense visual effects mandatory.

ownerDecisions.question: When may postlaunch content expansion begin?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Expansion begins only after onboarding, retention, storage, exploit, trade, and device metrics demonstrate a healthy foundation.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Additional content cannot repair a weak or unsafe core loop.

ownerDecisions.question: What is the final selected public name and which clearance gates remain?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: InfiniteCardCollector is the owner-selected public name. The name, logo, icon, thumbnails, and related public assets must still pass trademark, Roblox experience search, originality, provenance, policy, and owner acceptance gates before publication.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner has resolved the public name while preserving the independent clearance and asset-quality gates required for a safe release.

ownerDecisions.question: How are documentation and GitHub state synchronized?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Tracked documentation remains canonical, the wiki remains a navigation surface, and GitHub Issues, Project, milestones, pull requests, tags, and documentation are synchronized later without changing protected plan artifacts during execution.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Execution evidence belongs in ordinary project and GitHub records, not in the pinned plan set.
